test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 2

questions.question: At what price (in ₹) must an article costing ₹7,125 be marked in order that after giving discount of 5%, the profit is 25%?
A man buys a second-hand car for ₹2,33,000 and spends ₹52,000 on its repairs. What should be its selling price (in ₹) if he wants to earn a 17% profit?
The average of three numbers is 20. If two of these numbers are 13 and 21, the third number is:
A man receives ₹3864 per month as salary. He saves 25% of his salary every month. His expenditure per month is:
A dishonest shopkeeper promises to sell his goods at cost price. However, he uses a weight that actually weighs 36% less than what is written on it. Find his profit percentage.

Pipe A can fill a tank in 6 hours, pipe B can fill the same tank in 8 hours, and pipe C can fill the same tank in 24 hours. The time taken (in hours) by them to fill the same tank if they operate together is:
If the length of a cuboid is 12 cm, its breadth is 16 cm, and the volume of the cuboid is 6144 cm3, then find the height of the cuboid (in cm).

The base of a right prism is a triangular shape, with sides measuring 8 cm, 15 cm, and 17 cm. If the height of the prism is 22 cm, find its lateral surface area (in cm2) and volume (in cm3), respectively.

The difference (rounded off to one decimal place) of the compound interest (when interest is compounded annually) and the simple interest, if ₹68,600 is deposited at 3% rate of interest per annum for 2 years, is:
The average weight of Rakesh, Shivam and Rupesh is 45 kg. If the average weight of Rakesh and Shivam is 37 kg and that of Shivam and Rupesh is 46 kg, then the weight of Shivam (in kg) is:
The value of x in the proportion equation 12 : 76 :: 96 : x is:

A started a business with a capital of ₹334000. After 2 months, B joined him with a certain amount of capital. At the end of a year of A's starting the business, the profit was shared in the ratio 5 : 2. How much (in ₹) did B invest?
A bus is moving at a speed of 73 km/hr. If its speed is reduced by 95%, the new speed of the bus (in km/hr) will be:
Find the simple interest (in ₹) if a sum of ₹400 is borrowed for 9.5 years at 20% per annum rate of interest.
1% of 38% of a number is what percentage of that number?
The average age of 35 students of a class is 12 years. When 15 new students are admitted to the class, the average is increased by 0.6 years. The average age of the 15 new students is:
The average of 13 numbers is 8. If each number is multiplied by 5, then what will the new average be:

A hemispherical bowl of internal radius 12 cm is full of liquid. This liquid is to be filled into cylindrical container of diameter 6 cm and height 4 cm. Find the number of containers that are necessary to empty the bowl.
If A is the largest number less than 12345 that is divisible by each of the numbers 3, 5, 7 and 8, then the sum of the digits of A is:
